title: Quantitative Chemiluminescence Immunoassay for Growth Differentiation Factor-15
author: Zhang, Zhang, et al.
materials: NHS-LC-LC-Biotin (10 mM in DMSO or DMF)
Storage buffer 1 (0.1 % Tween20, 0.5 % PC-950, 1 % bovine serum albumin (BSA) in PBS)
NSP-DMAE-NHS (10 mM in DMSO or DMF)
Blocking reagent (Vitamin H in DMSO or DMF)
Storage buffer 2 (0.01 % TX-100, 0.3 % PC-300, 1 % Casein in PBS)

steps.title: Biotinylate capture antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare biotinylated capture antibody by dialysis, labeling, quenching and desalting.

substeps.instruction: Dialyze the capture antibody against PBS and dilute to 1 mg/mL; take 1 mg (1 mL) into a tube.
Add 3.3 µL of 10 mM NHS‑LC‑LC‑Biotin, stir and incubate 30 min at room temperature.
Add 10 µL of 1 M Tris buffer, mix and incubate 10 min at room temperature to quench the reaction.
Remove unreacted and hydrolyzed biotin by passing the mixture through a desalting column.

steps.title: Couple biotinylated antibody to magnetic particles
steps.instruction: Bind the biotinylated capture antibody to streptavidin magnetic beads, wash, block and resuspend to the final concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL streptavidin magnetic particles to a 15 mL flask tube.

Add 8 mL storage buffer 1, mix, place on a magnetic separator, discard the supernatant after the liquid clears; repeat this wash three times, then resuspend the beads in another 8 mL storage buffer 1.
Add 40 µL biotinylated capture antibody, mix well and rock for 0.5 h (30 min) at room temperature.
Repeat the storage‑buffer‑1 wash as described above.
Add 200 µL blocking reagent, incubate 15 min at room temperature on a rocker.
Repeat the storage‑buffer‑1 wash again.
Add 42 mL storage buffer 1 to bring the magnetic particle concentration to 0.4 mg/mL.

steps.title: Label tracer antibody with acridine ester
steps.instruction: Prepare acridine‑ester‑labeled tracer antibody, purify and dilute to working concentration.

substeps.instruction: Dialyze the tracer antibody against PBS and dilute to 1 mg/mL; take 1 mg (1 mL) into a tube.
Add 10 µL of 10 mM NSP‑DMAE‑NHS, protect from light and rock for 1 h at room temperature.
Add 20 µL L‑lysine (10 mg/mL), mix immediately and react for 10 min at room temperature on a blood‑mixing apparatus, avoiding light.
Purify the labeled tracer antibody using a desalting column to remove excess acridine ester.
Dilute the purified tracer antibody to 0.1 µg/mL with storage buffer 2.

steps.title: Perform chemiluminescence detection
steps.instruction: Run the CLIA on the i3000 analyzer using sample, capture and tracer reagents, then measure light output.

substeps.instruction: In a reaction vial, add 10 µL sample, 50 µL capture reagent (magnetic particles) and 100 µL tracer reagent; mix.
Incubate the mixture 10 min at 37 °C.
Add 200 µL pre‑excitation fluid (H₂O₂) and 200 µL excitation fluid (NaOH).
Measure the relative light units (RLU) with a 100 ms acquisition time; the GDF‑15 concentration is proportional to the RLU.
